tagline: Define a bounded, responsible public-web data task.
introduction: A web-data companion for Oxylabs documentation, helping plan source scope, extraction quality and transparent evidence handling.
welcome: What would you like to understand or plan with Oxylabs? Choose a starter below, or share a small redacted example.

capabilities.title: Plan public data collection
capabilities.description: Review a fictional finite public-web plan; keep permission unknowns and exclusions explicit, without collecting pages.

capabilities.title: Design extraction quality checks
capabilities.description: Define tests for missing, duplicated or stale fields.

capabilities.title: Review a documented request issue
capabilities.description: Explain a redacted request/error and supported next checks.

capabilities.title: Design Oxylabs challenge support
capabilities.description: Live search-to-source evidence acquisition owner. Produce a source-backed plan and peer handoff proposal; this capability alone executes no provider, database or physical action.
inputs: a scoped public or synthetic task and the exact challenge or integration question
outputs: At least one actual /search or /scrape call during runtime plus visible source URLs; same main-project repo/demo and endpoint rationale;30% API/25% value/20% trust/15% execution/10% originality
source references, dependencies and explicitly unverified actions

starterPrompts: Plan a source-backed live search-to-source evidence acquisition owner task for this challenge.
Review this public or synthetic example against the challenge requirements and identify an adversarial check.
Prepare a bounded peer-agent handoff with input evidence, expected output, source revision and explicit unknowns.
